cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate by C1: the only prominent strong anionic, Sodium Laureth Sulfate @7 (before Parfum @8), is the defining anionic; it has prominent buffers (Disodium Laureth Sulfosuccinate @3 and Sodium Lauryl Sulfoacetate @4 mild anionics, Lauryl Glucoside @6 nonionic) and no reinforcing route. Counter-signal: the chassis is led by mild anionics and the SLES is the last-listed cleansing surfactant, which argues for low; it lowers confidence to moderate and names low as neighbor but cannot move the C1 value. Laureth-9 @5 is in no C3 class (fatty-alcohol ethoxylate; listed comfort route Polidocanol), not a buffer.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Low: cleansing-led architecture; the only conditioning routes are a late cationic starch polymer (Hydroxypropyl Oxidized Starch PG-Trimonium Chloride @15, after Parfum @8) and trace sunflower oil @21, with Urea @2 as humectant. C2 not met (no silicone, no prominent payload lipid, no pearlizing route). Moderate is the neighbor if the starch polymer gives noticeable slip.
